s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic eye symptoms with progressive vision loss and conjunctival abnormalities
key_facts: 43-year-old man
Initial visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/30 OS
Vision deteriorated to 20/30 OD and counting fingers OS
Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis
Symblepharon formation present
Corneal neovascularizations observed
Conjunctival hyperemia noted
Conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology revealed an unspecific result

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic eye symptoms with progressive vision loss and conjunctival abnormalities
key_facts: 43-year-old man
Initial visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/30 OS
Vision deteriorated to 20/30 OD and counting fingers OS
Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis
Symblepharon formation present
Corneal neovascularizations observed
Conjunctival hyperemia noted
Conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology revealed an unspecific result

shortlist.label: Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid
shortlist.why_kept: Symblepharon formation and subconjunctival fibrosis are characteristic findings

shortlist.label: Mucous membrane pemphigoid (MMP)
shortlist.why_kept: Conjunctival hyperemia and corneal neovascularizations are consistent with MMP

shortlist.label: Chronic ocular graft-versus-host disease
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive vision loss and conjunctival abnormalities are possible in chronic ocular GVHD

shortlist.label: Stevens-Johnson syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Conjunctival hyperemia and corneal neovascularizations could be seen in SJS, although it is less likely given the chronic nature of symptoms

shortlist.label: Toxic epidermal necrolysis
shortlist.why_kept: Although less likely, TEN can cause severe conjunctival and corneal involvement, and should be considered in the differential diagnosis

raw.rationale: The presence of subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon formation, and corneal neovascularizations are characteristic findings in Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid, which is a chronic autoimmune disease that affects the conjunctiva and cornea.

rejected.label: Mucous membrane pemphigoid (MMP)
rejected.why: While MMP can also cause conjunctival scarring and symblepharon, the specific combination of findings and the lack of specific immunofluorescent histology results make Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chronic ocular graft-versus-host disease
rejected.why: This condition typically occurs in the context of a history of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, which is not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Stevens-Johnson syndrome
rejected.why: This is an acute condition that typically presents with widespread skin and mucous membrane lesions, which is not consistent with the chronic eye symptoms described in the vignette.

rejected.label: Toxic epidermal necrolysis
rejected.why: Similar to Stevens-Johnson syndrome, this is an acute and severe condition with widespread skin and mucous membrane involvement, which does not fit the chronic and localized eye symptoms in the vignette.
